items.descripcion: Celebrated since 1975 to promote environmental awareness in formal and non-formal education.
items.accion_del_dia: Share an environmental fact you recently learned with someone.

items.nombre: World Day for Reduction of CO₂ Emissions
items.descripcion: A day to raise awareness about reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
items.accion_del_dia: Use public transport or a bicycle instead of a car today.

items.descripcion: Commemorates the signing of the Ramsar Convention in 1971, the first international environmental treaty.
items.accion_del_dia: Visit or learn about a wetland near your city.

items.descripcion: Promotes access to clean and sustainable energy for all.
items.accion_del_dia: Unplug standby devices throughout the day.

items.descripcion: Proclaimed in 2013 by the UN to celebrate the world's wild flora and fauna.
items.accion_del_dia: Photograph and document local wildlife or flora in your area.

items.descripcion: Forests cover a third of Earth's surface and harbor 80% of biodiversity.
items.accion_del_dia: Plant a tree or adopt one through a local organization.

items.descripcion: Established in 1993. About 2 billion people lack access to safe drinking water.
items.accion_del_dia: Measure how much water you use today and aim to reduce it by 10%.

items.descripcion: WWF's global initiative: switch off lights for one hour to symbolize environmental commitment.
items.accion_del_dia: Turn off all lights in your home for at least one hour tonight.

items.descripcion: Earth Day, celebrated since 1970, is the world's largest secular environmental event.
items.accion_del_dia: Organize or join a cleanup activity in your community.

items.descripcion: Bees pollinate 75% of food crops. Their disappearance would threaten global food security.
items.accion_del_dia: Plant native flowers that attract pollinators in your home or community.

items.descripcion: Commemorates the adoption of the Convention on Biological Diversity in 1992.
items.accion_del_dia: Identify three plant or animal species that live alongside you.

items.descripcion: The world's largest environmental event, celebrated since 1974. Each year has a host country and theme.
items.accion_del_dia: Participate in or organize an environmental awareness activity in your community.

items.descripcion: Oceans produce 50% of the planet's oxygen and absorb 30% of emitted CO₂.
items.accion_del_dia: Avoid single-use plastic products to protect the oceans.

items.descripcion: Every year 12 million hectares of land are degraded, equivalent to the size of South Korea.
items.accion_del_dia: Use water efficiently and support sustainable farming practices.

items.descripcion: 5 trillion plastic bags are produced annually. Most end up in the environment.
items.accion_del_dia: Bring your own reusable bag when shopping today.

items.descripcion: Elephants are ecosystem engineers. Poaching continues to threaten their survival.
items.accion_del_dia: Avoid buying ivory or elephant-derived products.

items.nombre: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies
items.descripcion: Proclaimed in 2019. 99% of the world's population breathes air that exceeds WHO limits.
items.accion_del_dia: Choose to walk, cycle or use public transport today.

items.nombre: International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer
items.descripcion: Commemorates the signing of the Montreal Protocol in 1987, the most successful environmental treaty.
items.accion_del_dia: Avoid CFC aerosols and check that your refrigeration equipment has no leaks.

items.descripcion: Transport accounts for 25% of global CO₂ emissions.
items.accion_del_dia: Leave the car at home and use sustainable mobility alternatives today.

items.descripcion: Celebrated on the feast of St. Francis of Assisi, patron of animals, since 1931.
items.accion_del_dia: Show love and respect to all animals, domestic and wild.

items.descripcion: 820 million people go hungry. The food system is responsible for 30% of global emissions.
items.accion_del_dia: Reduce food waste: plan your shopping and use leftovers.

items.descripcion: The planet has already warmed 1.2°C above pre-industrial levels. The window for action is narrow.
items.accion_del_dia: Calculate your personal carbon footprint and define an action to reduce it.

items.descripcion: Alternative to Black Friday: a day of reflection on consumption and its environmental impact.
items.accion_del_dia: Spend 24 hours without buying anything new. Repair, swap or share.

items.descripcion: It takes 1,000 years to produce 3 cm of fertile soil. Degradation advances faster.
items.accion_del_dia: Avoid herbicides and practice composting at home.

items.descripcion: Mountains are home to 15% of the world's population and 85% of global biodiversity.
items.accion_del_dia: Learn about mountain glaciers and the impact of climate change on them.
